extDescription.message: Save watched videos, force resolution, auto-enable captions, reduce live delay and skip videos you already watched on YouTube.

watchedHint.message: Stores title, channel, watched time, duration, percentage and dates for every video you watch. Everything stays in this browser.

qualityHint.message: If the video does not offer the chosen quality, the best quality below it is used.

captionsHint.message: Uses the auto-generated track of that language when available, falling back to human captions or a translated track.

liveDelayHintIntro.message: Only affects live streams while they are playing: if playback drifts more than the chosen buffer behind the live edge, it speeds up by itself until it is back on target.

liveDelayRealTimeHint.message: Stays glued to the live edge. Pick it only with a fast and very stable connection, where a hiccup would become a visible pause.

liveDelay2sHint.message: Tiny cushion: absorbs short hiccups on fast connections while the delay stays almost imperceptible.

liveDelay5sHint.message: Balanced cushion for average connections: smoother playback, with a delay still clearly below YouTube's usual drift.

liveDelay10sHint.message: Extra cushion for slow or unstable connections: the lowest chance of stutter, with the largest delay of the options.

skipHint.message: On videos you already watched (90% or more), shows a button over the page that goes to the next video. With automatic skipping, it goes there by itself. Never applies to live streams.

debugHint.message: Prints extra information to the browser console. Useful when something is not working.

confirmClear.message: Delete the history of $count$ watched video(s)? This cannot be undone.

emptyWatched.message: No videos recorded yet. Watch something on YouTube and come back.

staleNotice.message: YT Essentials was updated - reload this page to keep it working.
